videos.script:
Until today, the planner's numbers were typed into its classes. Today it works them out. {{signal}} The tool is the signal: a value that says when it changes. You read one by calling it, and you change it with set or update.

{{computed}} A computed is a value worked out from other signals. You watch one in a small program that prints every time it computes. It computes nothing until somebody reads it, and only once until something it read has changed.

{{equality}} Then the bug every team meets in its first month. You push a session into an array that a signal holds, and the total does not move. A signal only notices a new value, not a changed one.

{{resource}} Resource is the signal that waits, here for the planner's data. You get the address wrong on purpose, and learn that fetch does not fail on a 404.

{{week}} At the end, the week's numbers come from the six sessions and today's date. Move today to the next week, and every number follows.
